native_mechanisms: Hang the two symbol strings on crossed row/column posts to form a lattice of cells, lighting each cell on demand with a match/mismatch/gap-valued spark
Fold the lattice along its anti-diagonal so all cells with equal row+column sum form a single crease (anti-diagonal wavefront)
Read three stacked crease-layers at once (diagonal d-2 and two offsets of d-1) and discard the spent bottom layer, keeping only two creases in flight
core_technique: Anti-diagonal (wavefront) Needleman-Wunsch: cells of constant i+j computed as one SIMD-vectorized diagonal from the two previous diagonals in rotating O(n) buffers, with b stored reversed for unit-stride access and int16/int32 width regimes plus a scalar small-n path
